history.p: According to a letter from Gade to Clara Schumann, Gade originally planned the three organ pieces as an organ sonata, but gave up the idea. Instead he decided to omit the first D minor movement and transposed the two last movement up a tone.

physDesc.physMedium: 3 bifolios and 1 single folio. Written in ink. Paper: 10 staves. Notated on 3 staves. Paginated 1-4 partly in Gade's hand. In upper right-hand corner on p. 1 added in pencil: "Op. 22." At the last stave on p. 1: "Niels W Gade" and Gade's musical signature. At the end of the Moderato on p. 5 dated "11 Juni 1851" and Gade's musical signature; at the end of the Andante on p. 6, which has been cancelled, dated "12 Juni 51"; at the end of the Allegretto on p. 8 Gade's musical signature and "16 Juni 51"; at the end of the Allegro con fuoco dated "23 Juni 51" and Gade's musical signature. Then follows 22 bars dated "24 Juni 51." and Gade's musical signature. On p. 14 an undated Allegro Maestoso.
